name: Smokeshire Hilltop Farms
description: In 262 Cemetery Rd, VT, Smokeshire Hilltop Farms grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
